readings.title: 17. When he Mentioned Satan and Sought Refuge from him
readings.arabicTitle: دُعَاؤُهُ إذا ذُكِرَ الشيطان فَاستَعاذَ مِنهُِ
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَزَغَـاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَائِدِهِ، وَمِنَ الثِّقَةِ بِأَمَـانِيِّهِ وَمَوَاعِيدِهِ وَغُرُورِهِ وَمَصَائِدِهِ، وَأَنْ يُطْمِعَ نَفْسَهُ فِي إضْلاَلِنَا
records.transliteration: allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika min nazaghati ash-shaytani ar-rajimi wa kaydihi wa maka'idih wa mina alththiqati bi'amanihi wa mawa'idih wa ghururihi wa masa'idih wa-an yuṭmiʿa nafsahu fī iḍlālinā
records.english_text: O God, we seek refuge in Thee from the instigations of the accursed Satan, his trickery, and his traps, from trust in his false hopes, his promises, his delusions, and his snares, and lest he should make himself crave to lead us away

records.arabic_text: عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَامْتِهَانِنَا بِمَعْصِيَتِكَ، أَوْ أَنْ يَحْسُنَ عِنْدَنَا مَا حَسَّنَ لَنَا، أَوْ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَرَّهَ إلَيْنَا.
records.transliteration: ʿan ṭāʿatika wa-amtihāninā bimaʿṣiyatika aw ʾan yahsun ʿindanā mā ḥassana lanā aw an yathqula ʿalayna ma karrh ilayna
records.english_text: from Thy obedience and to degrade us through our disobeying Thee, and lest what he has shown us as beautiful be beautiful for us and what he has shown us as detestable weigh down upon us.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اخْسَأْهُ عَنَّا بِعِبَادَتِكَ، وَاكْبِتْهُ بِدُؤوبِنَا فِي مَحَبَّتِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْراً لاَ يَهْتِكُهُ، وَرَدْماً مُصْمِتاً لا يَفْتُقُهُ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma akhsaʾhu ʿannā bi ʿibādataka wa akbit-hu biduʾūbinā fī maḥabbatika waajʿal baynana wa baynahu sitran la yaḥtikuhu waradmā musmitan lā yafthuquhu
records.english_text: O God, drive him away from us through Thy worship, throw him down through our perseverance in Thy love, and place between him and us a covering that he cannot tear away and a solid barrier that he cannot cut through!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ، وَاشْغَلْهُ عَنَّا بِبَعْضِ أَعْدَائِكَ، وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ، وَوَلِّنَا ظَهْرَهُ، وَاقْطَعْ عَنَّا إثْرَهُ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waashghalhu 'annaa biba'đi 'a'daa'ika waʿṣimnā minhu biḥusni riʿāyatika, wākfinā khatrah wa wallinā ẓahrahū, waqṭaʿ ʿannā iṯrahū
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, distract Satan from us with some of Thy enemies, preserve us from him through Thy good guarding, spare us his treachery, turn his back toward us, and cut off from us his trace!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَمْتِعْنَا مِنَ الْهُدَى، بِمِثْلِ ضَلاَلَتِهِ، وَزَوِّدْنَا مِنَ التَّقْوَى ضِدَّ غَوَايَتِهِ، وَاسْلُكْ بِنَـا مِنَ التُّقى خِـلافَ سَبِيلِهِ مِنَ الـرَّدى.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-amtiʿna min al-hudā, bimithli ḍalālatihi. wa zawwiddnā mina al-taqwá ḍidda ghawāyatihi wasluk binā mina al-taqwá khilāfa sabīlihi mina al-raddā
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, give us to enjoy guidance the like of his misguidance, increase us in piety against his seduction, and make us walk in reverential fear contrary to his path of ruin!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا مَدْخَلاً وَلاَ تُوطِنَنَّ لَهُ فِيمَا لَدَيْنَا مَنْزِلاً.
records.transliteration: allāhumma lā tajʿal lahū fī qulūbinā madkhalan walā tuṭinnan lahu fīmā ladaynā manzilan
records.english_text: O God, assign him no place of entrance into our hearts and do not allow him to make his home in that which is with us!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِل فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ وَإذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ، وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ، وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ، وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إلَيْهِ وَأَحْسِنْ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ عَوْنَنَا عَلَيْهِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma wamā sawwala lanā min bāṭil faʿarrisnāhu wa-iżā ʿarraftanāhu faqināhu, wa-baṣṣirnā mā nukāyiduhu bih wa alhimnā mā nuʿidduhu lahū, wa ayyiqznā ʿan sinati al-ghaflati bi'r-rukuuni ilayhi wa aḥsin bi tawfīqika ʿawnanā ʿalayh
records.english_text: O God, cause us to recognize the falsehood with which he tempts us, and once Thou hast caused us to recognize it, protect us from it! Make us see what will allow us to outwit him, inspire us with all that we can make ready for him, awaken us from the heedless slumber of relying upon him, and help us well, through Thy giving success, against him!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَشْرِبْ قُلُوبَنَـا إنْكَارَ عَمَلِهِ، وَالْـطُفْ لَنَا فِي نَقضِ حِيَلِهِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa ashrib qulūbanā inkāra ʿamalih wa al-ṭuf lanā fī naqḍi ḥīlih
records.english_text: O God, saturate our hearts with the rejection of his works and be gentle to us by destroying his stratagems!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَحَوِّلْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا، وَاقْطَعْ رَجَاءَهُ مِنَّا ، وادْرَأْه عَنِ الْوُلُوعِ بِنَا.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadi wa ālihi wa ḥawwil sultānahu ʿannā waqtʿ rajāʾahu minnā, wa adraʾhu ʿani al-wulūʿ bi nnā
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, turn his authority away from us, cut off his hope from us, and keep him from craving for us!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ آباءَنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَوْلاَدَنَا وَأَهَالِينَا وَذَوِي أَرْحَامِنَا وَقَرَابَاتِنَا وَجِيْرَانَنَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـاتِ مِنْهُ فِي حِرْز حَـارِز،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī wa'j'al aaba'ana wa umma'hatina wa awlaadana wa ahaleena wa dhawi arḥāminā wa qarābātinā wa jīrānā min al-muʾminīn wa al-muʾmināt minhu fī ḥirz ḥāriz
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, and place our fathers, our mothers, our children, our wives, our siblings, our relatives, and the faithful among our neighbours, male and female, in a sanctuary impregnable to him,

records.arabic_text: وَحِصْن حَافِظ ، وَكَهْف مَانِع، وَألْبِسْهُمْ مِنْهُ جُنَناً وَاقِيَةً، وَأَعْطِهِمْ عَلَيْهِ أَسْلِحَةً مَاضِيَةً
records.transliteration: wa-ḥiṣn ḥāfiẓ, wa-kahf māniʿ, wa-albis-hum minhu junanā waqiyatan wa'ațihim ʿalayhi asliḥatan māḍiyatan
records.english_text: a guarding fortress, a defending cave! Clothe them in shields protective against him and give them arms that will cut him down!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذلِكَ مَنْ شَهِدَ لَكَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ، وَأَخْلَصَ لَكَ بِالْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ، وَعَادَاهُ لَكَ بِحَقِيقَةِ الْعُبُودِيَّة، وَاسْتَظْهَرَ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَعْرِفَةِ الْعُلُومِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma wāʿimm bi dhālika man shahida laka bir-rubūbiyya wa-akhlasa laka bil-wahdāniyyati wa ʿādāhu laka bi-ḥaqīqati al-ʿubūdiyyah wa astaẓhar bi-ka ʿalayhi fī maʿrifat al-ʿulūm al-rrabbāniyyah
records.english_text: O God, include in that everyone who witnesses to Thee as Lord, devotes himself sincerely to Thy Unity, shows enmity toward him through the reality of servanthood, and seeks help from Thee against him through knowledge of the divine sciences!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ احْلُلْ مَا عَقَدَ، وَافْتقْ مَا رَتَقَ، وَافسَخ مَا دَبَّرَ، وَثَبِّطْهُ إذَا عَزَمَ، وَانْقُضْ مَا أَبْرَمَ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ahlul mā ʿaqada, wa aftiqh mā rataqa wāfisakh mā dabbara, wa thabbithhu idhā ʿazama, wa anquḍ mā ʾabrama
records.english_text: O God, undo what he ties, unstitch what he sews up, dislocate what he devises, frustrate him when he makes up his mind, and destroy what he establishes!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَاهْزِمْ جُنْدَهُ وَأَبْطِلْ كَيْدَهُ وَاهْدِمْ كَهْفَهُ وَأَرْغِمْ أَنْفَهُ.
records.transliteration: allahumma wahzim jundahu wa'abtil kaydahu waahdim kahfahu wa'arghim anfahu
records.english_text: O God, rout his troops, nullify his trickery, make his cave collapse, and rub his nose in the ground!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا فِي نَظْم أَعْدَآئِهِ وَاعْزِلْنَا عَنْ عِدَادِ أَوْلِيَائِهِ، لا نُطِيعُ لَهُ إذَا اسْتَهْوَانَا، وَلا نَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إذَا دَعَانَا
records.transliteration: allāhumma ijʿalnā fī naẓm aʿdāʾihi waʿzilnā ʿan ʿidādi awliyāʾihi lā nuṭīʿu lahu ʾiḏā istahwānā wa lā nastajību lahu idhā daʿānā
records.english_text: O God, place us in the ranks of his enemies and remove us from the number of his friends, that we obey him not when he entices us and answer him not when he calls to us!

records.arabic_text: نَأْمُرُ بِمُنَاوَاتِهِ مَنْ أَطَاعَ أَمْرَنَا وَنَعِظُ عَنْ مُتَابَعَتِهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ زَجْرَنَا.
records.transliteration: na'muru bimunāwātihim man 'aṭā'a amranā wa naʿiẓu ʿan mutābaʿatihi mani ittabaʿa zajranā
records.english_text: We command everyone who obeys our command to be his enemy and we admonish everyone who follows our prohibition not to follow him!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الـطَّاهِرِينَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad khātimin-nabiyyīn wa sayyidil-mursalīn wa ʿalā ʾahl baytihi al-ṭayyibīna al-ṭāhirīna
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad the Seal of the prophets and lord of the emissaries, and the folk of his house, the good, the pure!

records.arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنَا وَأَهَـالِينَا وَإخْـوَانَنَا وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِمَّا اسْتَعَذْنَا مِنْهُ، وَأَجِرْنَا مِمَّا اسْتَجَرْنَا بِكَ مِنْ خَوْفِهِ
records.transliteration: wa'a'ithna wa'ahalina wa'ikhwananā wa jamīʿa al-muʾminīna wa al-muʾmināti mimmā istaʿaḏnā minhu wa ajirna mimma astajarna bika min khawfihi
records.english_text: Give refuge to us, our families, our brothers, and all the faithful, male and female, from that from which we seek refuge, and grant us sanctuary from that through fear of which we seek sanctuary in Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَاسْمَعْ لَنَا مَا دَعَوْنَا بِهِ وَأَعْطِنَا مَا أَغْفَلْنَاهُ وَاحْفَظْ لَنَا مَا نَسِيْنَاهُ،
records.transliteration: wasmaʿ lana mā daʿawnā bihī waʾaʿṭinā mā aghfalnāhu waḥfiẓ lana mā nasīnā
records.english_text: Hear our supplication to Thee, bestow upon us that of which we have been heedless, and safeguard for us what we have forgotten!

records.arabic_text: وَصَيِّرْنَا بِذَلِكَ فِي دَرَجَاتِ الصَّالِحِينَ وَمَـرَاتِبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
records.transliteration: waṣayyirnā bi dhālika fī darajāt al-ṣāliḥīn wa marātib al-muʾminīn
records.english_text: Through all this bring us into the ranks of the righteous and the degrees of the faithful!

records.arabic_text: آمينَ رَبَّ ا لْعَالَمِينَ .
records.transliteration: ʾāmīn rabbi al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: Amen, Lord of the worlds!

readings.title: 18. When Perils were repelled or Requests quickly granted
readings.arabicTitle: دُعَاؤُهُ إذا دُفِعَ عَنهُ ما يَحذَرُ او عُجّلَ لَهُ مَطلَبُهُ
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ، وَبِمَا صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي مِنْ بَلائِكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma laka al-ḥamd ʿalā ḥusni qaḍāʾika wa bimā ṣarafta ʿannī min balāʾika
records.english_text: O God, to Thee belongs praise for Thy excellent accomplishment and for Thy trial which Thou hast turned away from me!

records.arabic_text: فَلاَ تَجْعَـلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ فَأكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
records.transliteration: fala tajʿal ḥaẓẓī min raḥmatika mā ʿajjalta lī min ʿāfiyatika fa'akūna qad shaqītu bimā aḥbabtu wa sa'ida ghayrī bimā karīhtu
records.english_text: But make not my share of Thy mercy the well-being which Thou hast quickly granted to me, lest I become wretched through what I have loved and someone else gain felicity through what I have disliked!

records.arabic_text: وَإنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاء لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْر لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ
records.transliteration: wa-in yakun ma zalliltu feehi aw bittu feehi min hadhihil-'afiya bayna yaday balaa laa yanqatiʿu, wa wizr laa yartafiʾu faqqaddim li mā akhkhart wa akhkhir ʿannī mā qaddamta
records.english_text: If this well-being in which I pass the day or night should precede a trial that does not cease and a burden that does not pass away, then set before me what Thou hadst set behind and set behind me what Thou hadst set before!

records.arabic_text: فَغَيْرُ كَثِير مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْفَنَاءُ، وَغَيْرُ قَلِيل مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْبَقَاءُ.
records.transliteration: faghayru kathir ma 'aqibatuhu al-fana' wa ghayru qalil ma ʿaqibatuhul baqaʾu
records.english_text: For that which ends in annihilation is not great and that which ends in subsistence is not little.

records.arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ.
records.transliteration: waṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih
records.english_text: And bless Muhammad and his Household!

readings.title: 19. His Supplication in Asking for Water during a Drought
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَـا الْغَيْثَ، وَانْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا رَحْمَتَـكَ بِغَيْثِكَ الْمُغْدِقِ مِنَ الْسَّحَابِ الْمُنْسَـاقِ لِنَبَاتِ أَرْضِكَ الْمُونِقِ فِي جَمِيـعِ الآفَاقِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma asqinā al-ghaytha wa anshur ʿalayna raḥmataka bi-ghaythika al-mughdiqu min al-sahabi al-munsāqi li-nabāti arḍika al-mūniqi fī jamīʿi al-āfāq
records.english_text: O God, water us with rain, unfold upon us Thy mercy through Thy copious rain from the driven clouds, so that Thy goodly earth may grow on all horizons!

records.arabic_text: وَامْنُنْ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ بِإينَاعِ الثَّمَرَةِ، وأَحْيِ بِلاَدَكَ بِبُلُوغِ الزَّهَرَةِ.
records.transliteration: wa-amnun ʿalaa ʿibaadika bi-iynaai ath-thamaraati wa ahyi biladaka bibulughiz-zahara
records.english_text: Show kindness to Thy servants through the ripening of the fruit, revive Thy land through the blossoming of the flowers,

records.arabic_text: وَأَشْهِدْ مَلائِكَتَكَ الْكِرَامَ السَّفَرَةَ بِسَقْي مِنْكَ نَافِع دَائِم غُزْرُهُ َواسِعٌ دِرَرُهُ وَابِل سَرِيع عَاجِل تُحْيِي بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَات، وَتَرُدُّ بهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ،
records.transliteration: wa ash-hid malā'ikataka al-kerāma al-safarata bi-saqin minka naafiʿ daaʾim ghuzruhu waāsiʿun diraruhu waābilun sareeʿun ʿajil tuḥyī bihī mā qad māt, wa taruddu bihī mā qad fāta
records.english_text: and let Thy angels - the noble scribes - be witness to a beneficial watering from Thee, lasting in its abundance, plenty in its flow, heavy, quick, soon, through which Thou revivest what has died, returnest what has vanished,

records.arabic_text: وَتُخْرِجُ بِهِ مَا هُوَ آت، وَتُوَسِّعُ بِهِ فِي الأَقْوَاتِ، سَحَاباً مُتَرَاكِماً هَنِيئاً مَرِيئاً طَبَقاً مُجَلْجَلاً غَيْرَ مُلِثٍّ وَدْقُهُ،
records.transliteration: wa tukhrijubihī mā huwa āt wa tuwasṣiʿu bihi fil-aqwāt saḥābān mutarākiman hanī'an mari'ian ṭabaqan mujaljalān ghayra mulithhin wa dquh
records.english_text: bringest forth what is coming, and providest plentiful foods, through heaped up, wholesome, productive clouds, in reverberating layers, the rain's downpour not without cease,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ خُلَّب بَرْقُهُ.
records.transliteration: walā khullab barquh
records.english_text: the lightning's flashes not without fruit!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مَغيثَاً مَرِيعاً مُمْرِعاً عَرِيْضَاً، وَاسِعاً غَزِيراً تَرُدُّ بِهِ النَّهِيضَ وَتَجْبُرُ بِهِ الْمَهِيضَ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma isqinā ghaythan maghīthan marīʿan mumriʿan ʿarīḍan waāsiʿan ghazīran taruddu bihī al-nahīḍa wa tajburu bihī al-mahīḍa
records.english_text: O God, give us water through rain, helping, productive, fertilizing, widespread, plentiful, abundant, bringing back the risen, restoring the broken!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا سَقْياً تُسِيلُ مِنْهُ الظِّرابَ، وَتَمْلاءُ مِنْهُ الْجِبَابَ، وَتُفَجِّرُ بِهِ الأنْهَارَ، وَتُنْبِتُ بِهِ الأشْجَارَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma asqinā saqiyan tusīlu minhu al-dhirāb wa tamla'u minhu al-jibab wa tufajjiru bihi al-anhaar wa tunbitu bihi al-ashjar
records.english_text: O God, give us water with a watering through which Thou wilt make the stone hills pour, fill the cisterns, flood the rivers, make the trees grow,

records.arabic_text: وَتُرْخِصُ بِهِ الأسْعَارَ فِي جَمِيع الأمْصَارِ، وَتَنْعَشُ بِهِ البَهَائِمَ وَالْخَلْقَ، وَتُكْمِلُ لَنَا بِهِ طَيِّبَاتِ الرِّزْقِ، وَتُنْبِتُ لَنَا بِهِ الزَّرْعَ،
records.transliteration: wa turkhisu bihi al-asʿara fi jamiʿi al-amsari wa tanʿashu bihi al-bahāʾima wal-khalq wa tukmilu lana bihi tayyibati ar-riżqi wa tunbitu lana bihi alzara'a
records.english_text: bring down prices in all the lands, invigorate the beasts and the creatures, perfect for us the agreeable things of provision, make grow for us the fields,

records.arabic_text: وَتُدِرُّ بِهِ الضَّرْعَ، وَتَزِيدُنَا بِهِ قُوَّةً إلَى قُوَّتِنَا.
records.transliteration: wa tudirru bihi ad-darʿa wa tazīdunā bihī quwwatan ilā quwwātinā
records.english_text: let flow for us the teats, and add for us strength to our strength!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُوماً وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ بَرْدَهُ عَلَيْنَا حُسُوماً، وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ صَوْبَهُ عَلَيْنَا رُجُوماً، وَلا تَجْعَلْ مَاءَهُ عَلَيْنَا أُجَاجـاً.
records.transliteration: allāhumma lā tajʿal ẓillahu ʿalaynā samūmāً wa lā tajʿal bardahu ʿalaynā ḥusūmā walā tajʿal ṣawbahu ʿalaynā rujūmāً walā tajʿal māʾahu ʿalaynā ujājāً
records.english_text: O God, make not the cloud's shadow over us a burning wind, allow not its coldness to be cutting, let not its pouring down upon us be a stoning, and make not its waters for us bitter!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَارْزُقْنَا مِنْ بَرَكَاتِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa arzuqnaa min barakaatil-samaawaati wal-ardh
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide us with the blessings of the heavens and the earth!

records.arabic_text: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
records.transliteration: innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
records.english_text: "Thou art powerful over everything"! (3:26)

readings.title: 20. His Supplication on Noble Moral Traits
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَبَلِّغْ بِإيْمَانِي أكْمَلَ الإِيْمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْ يَقِينِي أَفْضَلَ الْيَقِينِ، و انتَهِ بِنِيَّتِي إلَى أَحْسَنِ النِّيَّـاتِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi. wa balligh biimaanii akmalal-iimaan wajʿal yaqīnī afḍal al-yaqīn wa antahi biniyyati ila ahsanin-niyyat
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, cause my faith to reach the most perfect faith, make my certainty the most excellent certainty, and take my intention to the best of intentions

records.arabic_text: وَبِعَمَلِي إلى أَحْسَنِ الأعْمَالِ.
records.transliteration: wa bi'amalī ilā aḥsani al'aʿmāl
records.english_text: and my works to the best of works!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَفِّرْ بِلُطْفِكَ نِيَّتِي، وَصَحِّحْ بِمَـا عِنْدَكَ يَقِينِي، وَاسْتَصْلِحْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ مَا فَسَدَ مِنِّي.
records.transliteration: allāhumma waffir bi-lutfika niyyatī waṣaḥḥiḥ bimā ʿindaka yaqīnī wa-astaṣliḥ bi-qudratika mā fasaḍa minnī
records.english_text: O God, complete my intention through Thy gentleness, rectify my certainty through what is with Thee, and set right what is corrupt in me through Thy power!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْفِنِي مَا يَشْغَلُنِي الاهْتِمَامُ بِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا تَسْأَلُنِي غَداً عَنْهُ وَاسْتَفْرِغْ أَيَّامِي فِيمَا خَلَقْتَنِي لَهُ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-kfinī mā yašġalunī al-ihtimām bih wa astaʿmilnī bimā tasʾalunī ghadan ʿanh wastafriġ ayyāmī fīmā khalaqtanī lahu
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, spare me the concerns which distract me, employ me in that about which Thou wilt ask me tomorrow, and let me pass my days in that for which Thou hast created me!

records.arabic_text: وَأَغْنِنِي وَأَوْسِعْ عَلَىَّ فِي رِزْقِكَ، وَلاَ تَفْتِنِّي بِالبَطَرِ، وَأَعِزَّنِي، وَلا تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِالْكِبْرِ،
records.transliteration: wa 'agninī wa 'awsic ʿalayya fī rizqika wa lā tafitnī bil-baṭari, wa aʿizzanī, wa lā tabtiliyanī bil-kibr
records.english_text: Free me from need, expand Thy provision toward me, and tempt me not with ingratitude! Exalt me and afflict me not with pride!

records.arabic_text: وَعَبِّدْنِي لَكَ وَلاَ تُفْسِدْ عِبَادَتِي بِالْعُجْبِ،
records.transliteration: waʿabbidni laka wa lā tufsid ʿibādatī bil-ʿujb
records.english_text: Make me worship Thee and corrupt not my worship with self-admiration!

records.arabic_text: وَأَجْرِ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى يَدَيَّ الْخَيْرَ، وَلا تَمْحَقْهُ بِالْمَنِّ،
records.transliteration: wa ajri linnāsi ʿalā yadayyal khayra, wa lā tamḥaqhu bil manni
records.english_text: Let good flow out from my hands upon the people and efface it not by my making them feel obliged!

records.arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي مَعَالِيَ الأَخْلاَقِ، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الْفَخْرِ.
records.transliteration: wa hab li maʿāliya al-akhlaq, wa ʿaṣimni min al-fakhr
records.english_text: Give me the highest moral traits and preserve me from vainglory!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَلا تَـرْفَعْنِي فِيْ النَّاسِ دَرَجَـةً إلاّ حَطَطْتَنِي عِنْدَ نَفْسِي مِثْلَهَا، وَلا تُحْدِثْ لِي عِزّاً ظَاهِرَاً
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa lā tarfaʿnī fīl-nāsi darajah illā ḥaṭṭaṭtanī ʿinda nafsī mithlahā walā tuḥdiṯ lī ʿizzan ẓāhiran
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, raise me not a single degree before the people without lowering me its like in myself and bring about no outward exaltation for me

records.arabic_text: إلاّ أَحْدَثْتَ لِي ذِلَّةً بَاطِنَةً عِنْدَ نَفْسِي بِقَدَرِهَا.
records.transliteration: 'illā 'aḥdath-ta lī dhillatan bāṭinatan ʿinda nafsī biqadarihā
records.english_text: without an inward abasement in myself to the same measure!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَمَتِّعْنِي بِهُدىً صَالِح لا أَسْتَبْدِلُ بِهِ، وَطَرِيقَةِ حَقٍّ لا أَزِيْغُ عَنْهَا، وَنِيَّةِ رُشْد لاَ أَشُكُّ فِيْهَا
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa matti'ni bi hudan salihin la astabdilu bihi wa ṭarīqati ḥaqqin lā azīghu ʿanhā wa niyyati rushdin la ashukku fiha
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household, give me to enjoy a sound guidance which I seek not to replace, a path of truth from which I swerve not, and an intention of right conduct in which I have no doubts!

records.arabic_text: وَعَمِّرْنِي مَا كَانَ عُمْرِيْ بِذْلَةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، فَإذَا كَانَ عُمْرِي مَرْتَعَاً لِلشَّيْطَانِ فَـاقْبِضْنِي إلَيْـكَ قَبْـلَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَ مَقْتُـكَ إلَيَّ، أَوْ يَسْتَحْكِمَ غَضَبُكَ عَلَيَّ.
records.transliteration: waʿammirnī mā kāna ʿumrī bidhlatah fī ṭāʿatika fa'idha kana 'umri marta'an lish-shaytan fa'qbidhnee ilayka qabl'an yasbiqa maqtuka ilayya aw yastahkima ghadabuka 'alayya
records.english_text: Let me live as long as my life is a free gift in obeying Thee, but if my life should become a pasture for Satan, seize me to Thyself before Thy hatred overtakes me or Thy wrath against me becomes firm!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَدَعْ خَصْلَةً تُعَابُ مِنِّي إلاّ أَصْلَحْتَهَا، وَلا عَآئِبَةً أُؤَنَّبُ بِهَا إلاّ حَسَّنْتَهَا، وَلاَ أُكْرُومَـةً فِيَّ نَاقِصَةً إلاّ أَتْمَمْتَهَا.
records.transliteration: allāhumma lā tadaʿ khṣlaẗan tuʿābu minnī illā aṣlaḥtahā wala ʿāʾibatan uʾannabu bihā illa ḥassanṭahā wa lā ukroomatan fiyya nāqisatan illā atmamtahā
records.english_text: O God, deposit in me no quality for which I will be faulted, unless Thou settest it right, no flaw for which I will be blamed, unless Thou makest it beautiful, no deficient noble trait, unless Thou completest it!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد وَأَبْدِلْنِي مِنْ بِغْضَةِ أَهْلِ الشَّنَئانِ الْمَحَبَّةَ وَمِنْ حَسَدِ أَهْلِ الْبَغْيِ الْمَوَدَّةَ، وَمِنْ ظِنَّةِ أَهْلِ الصَّلاَحِ الثِّقَةَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa abdilni min bighdati ahli ash-shana'i al-mahabbah wa min hasadi ahli albaghyi almuwaddah wa min dhinnati ahl al-salāḥ al-thiqah
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household and replace for me the animosity of the people of hatred with love, the envy of the people of insolence with affection, the suspicion of the people of righteousness with trust,

records.arabic_text: وَمِنْ عَدَاوَةِ الأَدْنَيْنَ الْوَلايَةَ، وَمِنْ عُقُوقِ ذَوِي الأَرْحَامِ الْمَبَرَّةَ، ومِنْ خِـذْلانِ الأَقْرَبِينَ النُّصْـرَةَ، وَمِنْ حُبِّ الْمُدَارِينَ تَصْحيحَ الْمِقَةِ،
records.transliteration: wa min ʿadaawati al-adnayn al-wilaayatah wa min ʿuqūqi dhawī al-arḥām al-mabarrāh wa min khidhlaanil aqrabeen an-nusraht wa min ḥubbil-mudārīna taṣḥīḥal-miqah
records.english_text: the enmity of those close with friendship, the disrespect of womb relatives with devotion, the abandonment of relatives with help, the attachment of flatterers with love set right,

records.arabic_text: وَمِنْ رَدِّ الْمُلاَبِسِينَ َكَرَمَ الْعِشْرَةِ، وَمِنْ مَرَارَةِ خَوْفِ الظَّالِمِينَ حَلاَوَةَ الأَمَنَةِ.
records.transliteration: wa min raddi al-mulabisin karama al-ʿishrati wa min marārati khawfi alẓẓālimīna ḥalāwata al-amānat
records.english_text: the rejection of fellows with generous friendliness, and the bitterness of the fear of wrongdoers with the sweetness of security!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ يَداً عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِي وَلِسَـاناً عَلَى مَنْ خَـاصَمَنِي وَظَفَراً بِمَنْ عَانَدَنِي
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wajʿal li yadan ʿalā man ẓalamani walisānan ʿalā man khāṣamanī waẓafran biman ʿanadani
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, appoint for me a hand against him who wrongs me, a tongue against him who disputes with me, and a victory over him who stubbornly resists me!

records.arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي مَكْراً عَلَى مَنْ كَايَدَنِي وَقُدْرَةً عَلَى مَنِ اضْطَهَدَنِي وَتَكْذِيباً لِمَنْ قَصَبَنِي وَسَلاَمَةً مِمَّنْ تَوَعِّدَنِي
records.transliteration: wa hab li makran ʿala man kayadanī wa qudratan ʿalā mani iḍṭahadani wa takdhiban liman qasabani wasalāmata min man tawaʿaddanī
records.english_text: Give me guile against him who schemes against me, power over him who oppresses me, refutation of him who reviles me, and safety from him who threatens me!

records.arabic_text: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِطَاعَةِ مَنْ سَدَّدَنِي وَمُتَابَعَةِ مَنْ أَرْشَدَنِي
records.transliteration: wa waffiqnī li-ṭāʿati man saddadnī wa mutābaʿat(i) man ʾarshadani
records.english_text: Grant me success to obey him who points me straight and follow him who guides me right!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَسَدِّدْنِي لاَِنْ أعَـارِضَ مَنْ غَشَّنِي بِالنُّصْـحِ، وَأَجْـزِيَ مَنْ هَجَرَنِي بِالْبِرِّ وَأُثِيبَ مَنْ حَرَمَنِي بِالْبَذْلِ وَأُكَافِيَ مَنْ قَطَعَنِي بِالصِّلَةِ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wasaddidnī lā 'aʿāriḍa man ghashshanī bin-nuṣḥi wa ajziya man hajaranee bilbirri wa uthiiba man haramanee bilbazl wa ʾukāfiya man qaṭaʿanī bi-ṣ-ṣilah
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and point me straight to resist him who is dishonest toward me with good counsel, repay him who separates from me with gentle devotion, reward him who deprives me with free giving, recompense him who cuts me off with joining,

records.arabic_text: وأُخَـالِفَ مَنِ اغْتَابَنِي إلَى حُسْنِ الذِّكْرِ، وَأَنْ أَشْكرَ الْحَسَنَةَ وَاُغْضِيَ عَنِ السَّيِّئَـةِ.
records.transliteration: wa ukhālifa mani ightabanī ilā husni al-dhikr waan ashkura al-hasanah waoghdhiya ani al-sayyi'ah
records.english_text: oppose him who slanders me with excellent mention, give thanks for good, and shut my eyes to evil!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَحَلِّنِي بِحِلْيَـةِ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَأَلْبِسْنِي زِينَةَ المُتَّقِينَ فِيْ بَسْطِ الْعَدْلِ وَكَظْمِ الْغَيْظِ وَإطْفَاءِ النَّائِرَةِ وَضَمِّ أَهْلِ الْفُرْقَةِ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa hallinī bihil-yati al-ṣāliḥīn wa albisni zeenata almuttaqeen fi basṭi alʿadl wa kaẓmil-ghayẓi wa iṭfā'i an-nā'irati wa ḍammi ahlil-furqaẗi
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, adorn me with the adornment of the righteous, and clothe me in the ornaments of the godfearing, through spreading justice, restraining rage, quenching the flame of hate, bringing together the people of separation,

records.arabic_text: وَإصْلاَحِ ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ وَإفْشَاءِ الْعَارِفَةِ، وَسَتْرِ الْعَائِبَةِ، وَلِينِ الْعَرِيكَةِ، وَخَفْضِ الْجَنَـاحِ، وَحُسْنِ السِّيرَةِ، وَسُكُونِ الرِّيـحِ، وَطِيْبِ الْمُخَالَقَـةِ،
records.transliteration: wa-iṣlāḥi dhātil-bayni wa-ifshāʾil-ʿārifati wa satr al-ʿāʾibah, wa līni al-ʿarīkah wa khafḍi al-janāḥi, wa ḥusni al-sīrati wa sukūni ar-rihi, wa ṭībi al-mukhālaqah
records.english_text: correcting discord, spreading about good behaviour, covering faults, mildness of temper, lowering the wing, beauty of conduct, gravity of bearing, agreeableness in comportment,

records.arabic_text: وَالسَّبْقِ إلَى الْفَضِيلَةِ، وإيْثَارِ التَّفَضُّلِ و تَركِ التَّعييرِ، وَالإفْضَالِ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْمُسْتَحِقِّ وَالـقَوْلِ بِالْحَقِّ وَإنْ عَـزَّ وَاسْتِقْلاَلِ الخَيْـرِ وَإنْ كَثُـرَ مِنْ قَـوْلِي وَفِعْلِي ، وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الشَّرِّ وَإنْ قَلَّ مِنْ قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي،
records.transliteration: wal-sabqi ila al-faḍilah, wa-īthāri al-tafaddul wa-tarki al-taʿīr wa al-ifdali ʿalā ghayr al-mustahiqq wa al-qawli bil-haqqi wa-in ʿazz wa-istiqlāli-l-khayri wa-in kathura min qawli wa-fiʿli wa as-tikthārī ash-sharri wa in qalla min qawli wa fiʿli
records.english_text: precedence in reaching excellence, preferring bounteousness, refraining from condemnation, bestowing bounty on the undeserving, speaking the truth, though it be painful, making little of the good in my words and deeds, though it be much, and making much of the evil in my words and deeds, though it be little!

records.arabic_text: وَأكْمِلْ ذَلِكَ لِي بِدَوَامِ الطَّاعَةِ وَلُزُومِ الْجَمَاعَةِ وَرَفْضِ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ وَمُسْتَعْمِلِ الرَّأي الْمُخْتَرَعِ.
records.transliteration: waakmil dhālika lī bidawāmi aṭ-ṭāʿati waluzūmi aljamāʿati wa rafḍi ahlil bidʿati wa mustaʿmili r-raʾyi l-mukhtariʿi
records.english_text: Perfect this for me through lasting obedience, holding fast to the community, and rejecting the people of innovation and those who act in accordance with original opinions!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ إذَا كَبُرتُ ، وَأَقْوَى قُوَّتِكَ فِيَّ إذَا نَصِبْتُ، وَلاَ تَبْتَلِيَنّي بِالكَسَلِ عَنْ عِبَادَتِكَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-jaʿal awsaa rizqika ʿalayya idhaa kaburtu wa aqwā quwwatika fīyā 'iḏā naṣibtu walā tabtalīnī bilkasal ʿan ʿibādatik
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, appoint for me Thy widest provision in my old age and Thy strongest strength when I am exhausted, try me not with laziness in worship of Thee,

records.arabic_text: وَلا الْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ وَلاَ بِالتَّعَرُّضِ لِخِلاَفِ مَحَبَّتِكَ، وَلاَ مُجَامَعَةِ مَنْ تَفَرَّقَ عَنْكَ، وَلا مُفَارَقَةِ مَنِ اجْتَمَعَ إلَيْكَ.
records.transliteration: wa lā al-ʿamā ʿan sabīlika wa lā bit-taʿarruḍi li-khilāfi maḥabbatika wa lā mujāmaʿati man tafarraqa ʿanka walā mufāraqaẗi mani ʾjtamaʿa ʾilayk
records.english_text: blindness toward Thy path, undertaking what opposes love for Thee, joining with him who has separated himself from Thee, and separating from him who has joined himself to Thee!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أصُوْلُ بِكَ عِنْدَ الضَّرُورَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ عِنْدَ الْحَاجَةِ، وَأَتَضَرَّعُ إلَيْكَ عِنْدَ الْمَسْكَنَةِ ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ajʿalnī aṣūlu bika ʿinda alḍarūrah wa asʾaluka ʿinda al-ḥājah waataḍarraʿu ilayka ʿinda al-maskanah
records.english_text: O God, make me leap to Thee in times of distress, ask from Thee in needs, and plead to Thee in misery!

records.arabic_text: وَلا تَفْتِنّي بِالاسْتِعَانَةِ بِغَيْرِكَ إذَا اضْطُرِرْتُ، وَلا بِالْخُضُوعِ لِسُؤالِ غَيْرِكَ إذَا افْتَقَـرْتُ ، وَلاَ بِـالتَّضَـرُّعِ إلَى مَنْ دُونَـكَ إذَا رَهِبْتُ فَأَسْتَحِقَّ بِذلِكَ خِذْلانَكَ
records.transliteration: wa lā taf-tin-nī bil-istiaʿāna bi-ghay-rika idhā iḍ-ṭur-ritu walā bil-khuḍūʿ li-suʾāl ghayrika idhā iftaqaṛtu walā bit-ṭaḍarruʿ ilā man dūnaka iḏā rahibtu fa'astahiqqa bidhālika khiḍlānaka
records.english_text: Tempt me not to seek help from other than Thee when I am distressed, to humble myself in asking from someone else when I am poor, or to plead with someone less than Thee when I fear, for then I would deserve Thy abandonment,

records.arabic_text: وَمَنْعَكَ وَإعْرَاضَكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa-manʿaka wa-iʿrāḍaka yā arḥama al-rāḥimīn
records.english_text: Thy withholding, and Thy turning away, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِي رَوْعِي مِنَ التَّمَنِّي وَالتَّظَنِّي وَالْحَسَـدِ ذِكْـراً لِعَظَمَتِكَ، وَتَفَكُّراً فِي قُدْرَتِكَ، وَتَدْبِيراً عَلَى عَدُوِّكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ijʿal mā yulqī al-shayṭān fī rawʿī min al-tamannī wa al-taẓannī wa al-ḥasad dhikran liʿaẓamatika wa tafakkuran fi qudratika wa tadbeeraan ʿalaa ʿaduwwika
records.english_text: O God, make the wishing, the doubt, and the envy which Satan throws into my heart a remembrance of Thy mightiness, a reflection upon Thy power, and a devising against Thy enemy!

records.arabic_text: وَمَا أَجْرَى عَلَى لِسَانِي مِنْ لَفْظَةِ فُحْش أَوْ هُجْر أَوْ شَتْمِ عِرْض أَوْ شَهَادَةِ بَاطِل أو اغْتِيَابِ مُؤْمِن غَائِبِ أَوْ سَبِّ حَاضِر، وَمَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ نُطْقاً بِالْحَمْدِ لَكَ
records.transliteration: wa mā ajrā ʿalā lisānī min lafẓati fuhshin aw hujr aw shatmi ʿirḍin aw shahādati bāṭil aw ightiyabi mu'min gha'ibin aw sabb haadir wa mā ashbahadhā nuṭqan bil-ḥamdi laka
records.english_text: Make everything he causes to pass over my tongue, - the indecent or ugly words, the maligning of good repute, the false witness, the speaking ill of an absent man of faith or the reviling of one present, and all things similar - a speech in praise of Thee,

records.arabic_text: وَإغْرَاقاً فِي الثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْكَ، وَذَهَاباً فِي تَمْجيدِكَ وَشُكْراً لِنِعْمَتِكَ وَاعْتِرَافاً بِإحْسَانِكَ
records.transliteration: wa ʾighrāqan fī althannāʾi ʿalayk wa dhahaban fi tamjeedik wa shukran li ni'matik waʿtirafan bi-ihsanika
records.english_text: a pursual of eulogizing Thee, an excursion in magnifying Thee, a thanksgiving for Thy favour, an acknowledgement of Thy beneficence,

records.arabic_text: وَإحْصَاءً لِمِنَنِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa-ihsā'an liminannika
records.english_text: and an enumeration of Thy kindnesses!

records.arabic_text: أللّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَلاَ اُظْلَمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ مُطِيقٌ لِلدَّفْعِ عَنِّي، وَلا أَظْلِمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ القَادِرُ عَلَى الْقَبْضِ مِنِّي، وَلاَ أَضِلَّنَّ وَقَدْ أَمْكَنَتْكَ هِدَايَتِي،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa lā uẓ'laman wa anta muṭīqun lid-daf'i 'anni walā ʾaẓlimanna waʾanta al-qādiru ʿalā al-qabḍi minnī walā 'aḍillann waqad amkantaka hidāyatī
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, let me not be wronged while Thou canst repel from me, let me not do wrong while Thou art powerful over holding me back, let me not be misguided while Thou art able to guide me,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ أَفْتَقِرَنَّ وَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ وُسْعِي، وَلا أَطْغَيَنَّ وَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ وُجْدِي.
records.transliteration: wala aftaqiranna wa min ʿindika wusʿi walā aṭghayanna wa min ʿindika wujdī
records.english_text: let me not be poor while with Thee is my plenty, let me not be insolent while from Thee comes my wealth!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إلَى مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَفَدْتُ، وَإلَى عَفْوِكَ قَصَـدْتُ، وَإلَى تَجَـاوُزِكَ اشْتَقْتُ، وَبِفَضْلِكَ وَثِقْتُ، وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي مَا يُوجِبُ لِي مَغْفِرَتَكَ، وَلاَ فِي عَمَلِي مَا أَسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ عَفْوَكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ilā maghfiratika wafadtu, wa ilā ʿafwik qasadtu wa'ilā tajāwuzu-ka ʾishtaqtu, wa-bifaḍli-ka wa-thiqtu wa laysa ʿindi mā yūjibulī maghfirataka wala fi ʿamalī mā astaḥiqqu bihī ʿafwaka
records.english_text: O God, I come to Thy forgiveness, I go straight to Thy pardon, I yearn for Thy forbearance, and I trust in Thy bounty, but there is nothing with me to make me warrant Thy forgiveness, nothing in my works to make me merit Thy pardon,

records.arabic_text: وَمَا لِي بَعْدَ أَنْ حَكَمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاَّ فَضْلُكَ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ
records.transliteration: wa mā lī baʿda an ḥakamtu ʿalā nafsī illā faḍluka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa tafadhal 'alayya
records.english_text: and nothing on my behalf after I judge my soul but Thy bounty, so bless Muhammad and his Household and bestow Thy bounty upon me!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنْطِقْنِي بِالْهُدى، وَأَلْهِمْنِي ألتَّقْـوَى وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلَّتِيْ هِيَ أَزْكَى وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا هُوَ أَرْضَى.
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa anṭiqnī bil-hudā wa alhimnī al-taqwā wa waffiqnī lil-lati hiya azkā waastaʿmilni bimā huwa arḍā
records.english_text: O God, make my speech be guidance, inspire me with reverential fear, give me success in that which is most pure, and employ me in what is most pleasing to Thee!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْلُكْ بِيَ الطَّرِيقَـةَ الْمُثْلَى، وَاجْعَلْنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَى.
records.transliteration: allāhumma asluk biyaṭ-ṭarīqah al-muthla waaj'alni ʿalaa millatika amuutu wa ahyaa
records.english_text: O God, let me tread the most exemplary path and make me live and die in Thy creed!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَمَتِّعْنِي بِالاقْتِصَادِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّدَادِ، وَمِنْ أَدِلَّةِ الرَّشَادِ، وَمِنْ صَالِحِي الْعِبَادِ، وَارْزُقْنِي فَوْزَ الْمَعَادِ، وَسَلاَمَةَ الْمِرْصَادِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa mattiʿnī bil-iqtisād, wa-ijʿalnī min ahl al-siddād wa min adillatir-rashadi, wa min salihi-l-'ibad wa-rzuqni fawza al-maʿad wa-salamata al-mirsad
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, give me to enjoy moderation, make me into one of the people of right behaviour, the proofs of right conduct, and the servants of righteousness, and provide me with triumph at the place of Return and safety from the Ambush!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ خُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ مِنْ نَفْسِي مَـا يُخَلِّصُهَا، وَأَبْق لِنَفْسِي مِنْ نَفْسِي مَـا يُصْلِحُهَا; فَإنَّ نَفْسِي هَالِكَةٌ أَوْ تَعْصِمَهَا.
records.transliteration: allāhumma khudh li-nafsika min nafsī mā yukhallisuhā wa-abq li-nafsi min nafsi ma yuslihuha fa'inna nafsi halikatun aw taʿsimaha
records.english_text: O God, take to Thyself from my soul what will purify it and leave for my soul that of my soul that will set it right, for my soul will perish unless Thou preservest it!

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عُدَّتِي إنْ حَزِنْتُ، وَأَنْتَ مُنْتَجَعِي إنْ حُرِمْتُ، وَبِكَ استِغَاثَتِي إنْ كَرِثْتُ، وَعِنْدَكَ مِمَّا فَاتَ خَلَفٌ، وَلِمَا فَسَدَ صَلاَحٌ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma anta ʿuddatī in hazintu wa anta muntajaʿī in ḥurimtu wa bika istighāthatī in karithtu waʿindaka mimmā fāta khalafun, wa limā fasada ṣalāḥun
records.english_text: O God, Thou art my stores when I sorrow, Thou art my recourse when I am deprived, from Thee I seek aid when troubled and with Thee is a substitute for everything gone by, a correction for everything corrupted,

records.arabic_text: وَفِيمَا أنْكَرْتَ تَغْييرٌ.
records.transliteration: wa fee maa ankarta taghyeerun
records.english_text: and a change from everything Thou disapprovest.

records.arabic_text: فَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ قَبْلَ الْبَلاءِ بِالْعَافِيَةِ، وَقَبْلَ الطَّلَبِ بِالْجِدةِ، وَقَبْلَ الضَّلاَلِ بِالرَّشَادِ، وَاكْفِنِي مَؤُونَةَ مَعَرَّةِ الْعِبَادِ، وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمْنَ يَوْمِ الْمَعَادِ، وَامْنَحنِي حُسْنَ الارْشَادِ.
records.transliteration: faamnun ʿalayya qabla al-balāʾi bil-ʿāfiyah, waqabla al-ṭalabi bil-jiddah wa-qabla al-ḍalāli bi al-rashād, wa-kfinī maʾūnat maʿarrat al-ʿibād wa-hab-li amna yawm al-ma'ad, wa-amnahni husna al-irshad
records.english_text: So show kindness to me with well-being before affliction, wealth before asking, right conduct before misguidance; suffice me against the burden of shame toward the servants, give me security on the Day of Return, and grant me excellent right guidance!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَادْرَأ عَنّي بِلُطْفِـكَ، وَاغْـذُنِي بِنِعْمَتِكَ، وَأَصْلِحْنِي بِكَرَمِـكَ، وَدَاوِنِي بصُنْعِـكَ، وَأَظِلَّنِيْ فِي ذَرَاكَ، وجَلِّلْنِي رِضَـاكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wadraʾ ʿannī bilutfi-ka, wa-aghzhunī biniʿmati-ka wa aslihni bika ramik, wa dāwinī bi ṣunʿik wa-aẓillanī fī dharak, wajallilnī riḍāka
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, repel from me through Thy gentleness, feed me through Thy favour, set me right through Thy generosity, heal me through Thy benefaction, shade me in Thy shelter, wrap me in Thy good pleasure,

records.arabic_text: وَوَفِّقنِي إذَا اشْتَكَلَتْ عَلَيَّ الأمُـورُ لأِهْدَاهَـا، وَإذَا تَشَابَهَتِ الأعْمَالُ لأزْكَاهَا، وَإذَا تَنَاقَضَتِ الْمِلَلُ لأِرْضَاهَا.
records.transliteration: wa waffiqnī idhā ishtakaltu ʿalayya al-amūru li-ahdāhā wa idha tashabahatil a'malu li-azkahā wa idha tanāqadhat al-milalu li-ardhāhā
records.english_text: and give me success to reach the most guided of affairs when affairs confuse me, the purest of works when works seem similar, and the most pleasing to Thee of creeds when creeds conflict!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَتَوِّجْنِي بِالْكِفَايَةِ، وَسُمْنِي حُسْنَ الْوِلايَةِ، وَهَبْ لِيْ صِدْقَ الْهِدَايَةِ، وَلا تَفْتِنِّي بِالسَّعَةِ، وَامْنَحْنِي حُسْنَ الدَّعَةِ، وَلا تَجْعَلْ عَيْشِي كَدّاً كَدّاً،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa tawwijnii bilkifāyati, wa sumnii ḥusnal-wilāyah wa hab li ṣidq al-hidāyah, wa lā tafṭinnī bis-saʿah wa-amnahnī ḥusna al-dʿah, wa-lā tajʿal ʿayshī kaddān kaddān
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, crown me with sufficiency, place in me excellent guardianship, give me to guide correctly, tempt me not with plenty, grant me excellent ease, make not my life toil and trouble,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَرُدَّ دُعَائِي عَلَيَّ رَدّاً; فَإنِّي لا أَجْعَلُ لَكَ ضِدّاً وَلا أَدْعُو مَعَكَ نِدّاً.
records.transliteration: wa lā turuddannā duʿāʾī ʿalayya raddan fa'inni la aj'alulika ḍiddan walā adʿū ma'aka niddan
records.english_text: and refuse not my supplication in rejection, for I make none rival to Thee and I supplicate none with Thee as equal!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـد وَآلِـهِ وَامْنَعْنِي مِنَ السَّرَفِ وَحَصِّنْ رِزْقِي مِنَ التَّلَفِ، وَوَفِّرْ مَلَكَتِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ فِيهِ، وَأَصِبْ بِي سَبِيلَ الْهِدَايَةِ لِلْبِرِّ فِيمَا اُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-amnaʿnī mina s-sarafi wa-ḥaṣṣin rizqī mina t-talafi wa waffir malakati bil-barakati fiih wa-aṣib biy sabīl al-hidāyati lilbirri fīmā onfiqu minhu
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, hold me back from prodigality, fortify my provision against ruin, increase my possessions through blessing them, and set me upon the path of guidance through piety in what I spend!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْفِنِي مَؤُونَةَ الاكْتِسَابِ، وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ غَيْرِ احْتِسَاب، فَلاَ أَشْتَغِلَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِكَ بِالطَّلَبِ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wākfinī maʾūnat al-iktisāb wa-arzuqni min ghayr ihtisab fala ash taghila ʿan ʿibadatika bit talabi
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, spare me the burden of earning, and provide for me without reckoning, lest I be distracted from Thy worship through seeking

records.arabic_text: وَلا أَحْتَمِلَ إصْرَ تَبِعَاتِ الْمَكْسَبِ.
records.transliteration: wa lā aḥtamila iṣra tabiʿāt al-maksab
records.english_text: and carry the load of earning's ill results!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَأَطْلِبْنِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ مَا أَطْلُبُ، وَأَجِرْنِي بِعِزَّتِكَ مِمَّا أَرْهَبُ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma fa'aṭlibnī biqudratika mā aṭlubu wa-ajirnī bi-ʿizzatika mimmā arhabu
records.english_text: O God, bestow upon me what I seek through Thy power and grant me sanctuary from what I fear through Thy might!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَصُنْ وَجْهِي بِالْيَسَارِ، وَلاَ تَبْتَذِلْ جَاهِي بِالإقْتارِ فَأَسْتَرْزِقَ أَهْلَ رِزْقِكَ، وَأَسْتَعْطِيَ شِرَارَ خَلْقِكَ، فَأفْتَتِنَ بِحَمْدِ مَنْ أَعْطَانِي، وَاُبْتَلَى بِـذَمِّ مَنْ مَنَعَنِي وَأَنْتَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ وَلِيُّ الإعْطَاءِ وَالْمَنْعِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa ṣun wajhī bil yasār wala tabtadhil jahi bi al-iqtar fa astarziq ahla rizqika wa-astaʿtiya shirāra khalqika, fa-afatatina bi-hamdi man ʾaʿtānī wa 'ubtila bi-thammi man manaʿanī wa 'anta min dūnihim wa waliyyu al-iʿtāʾi wal-maniʿi
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, save my face through ease, and demean not my dignity through neediness, lest I seek provision from those whom Thou hast provided and asks for bestowal from the worst of Thy creatures! Then I would be tried by praising him who gave to me and afflicted with blaming him who held back from me, while Thou - not they - art patron of giving and holding back.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـةِ وَارْزُقْنِي صِحَّةً فِيْ عِبَادَة، وَفَراغاً فِي زَهَادَة، وَعِلْماً فِي اسْتِعمَـال، وَوَرَعـاً فِي إجْمَال.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih warzuqny ṣiḥḥatan fī ʿibādah wa faraghān fī zahādah waʿilman fi istiʿmal, wa waraʿan fi ijmal
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide me with soundness in worship, detachment in renunciation, knowledge put into action, and abstinence in measure!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اخْتِمْ بِعَفْوِكَ أَجَلي، وَحَقِّقْ فِي رَجَاءِ رَحْمَتِكَ أَمَلِي، وَسَهِّلْ إلَى بُلُوغِ رِضَاكَ سُبُلِي، وَحَسِّن فِي جَمِيعِ أَحْوَالِيْ عَمَلِي.
records.transliteration: allāhumma akhtim biʿafwik ajalī wa ḥaqqiq fī rajā'i raḥmatika amalī wa sahhil ila bulugh ridak subuli wa ḥassin fī jamīʿi aḥwālī ʿamalī
records.english_text: O God, seal my term with Thy pardon, verify my expectation in hoping for Thy mercy, smooth my paths to reach Thy good pleasure, and make my works good in all my states!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَنَبِّهْنِي لِذِكْرِكَ فِي أَوْقَاتِ الْغَفْلَةِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِطَاعَتِـكَ فِي أَيَّامِ الْمُهْلَةِ، وَانْهَجْ لِي إلى مَحَبَّتِكَ سَبيلاً سَهْلَةً
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-nabbihni li-thikrika fi awqati al-ghaflah wa astaʿmilnī bi-ṭāʿatika fī ayyāmi al-muhlah wa-anhaj li ila mahabbatika sabeelan sahla
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, incite me to remember Thee in times of heedlessness, employ me in Thy obedience in days of disregard, open a smooth road for me to Thy love,

records.arabic_text: أكْمِلْ لِي بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِـرَةِ.
records.transliteration: akmil li bihā khayra al-dunyā wa-l-ākhira
records.english_text: and complete for me thereby the good of this world and the next

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَأَفْضَلِ مَـا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ قَبْلَهُ، وَأَنْتَ مُصَلٍّ عَلَى أَحَد بَعْدَهُ، وَآتِنا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ka'afdali ma sallayta 'ala ahadin min khalkika qablahu wa anta musalliyan ʿalaa ahadin baʿdahu wa ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanatan
records.english_text: O God, and bless Muhammad and his Household the best Thou hast blessed any of Thy creatures before him and wilt bless any of them after him, and "give to us in this World good, and in the next world good" (2:201),

records.arabic_text: وَقِنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
records.transliteration: wa qinī bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba al-nār
records.english_text: and protect me through Thy mercy "from the chastisement of the Fire" (2:201)!
